description.zh:
指定要清除的登录凭据类型。取值：
- **Password**：密码
- **PrivateKey**：SSH私钥
description.en:
The type of logon credential to clear. Valid values:

- **Password**: The password.

- **PrivateKey**: The SSH private key.

description.zh:
指定要清除登录凭据的主机账户ID。
> 您可以调用[ListHostAccounts](~~204372~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the host account. The logon credential of this account will be cleared.

> Call the [ListHostAccounts](~~204372~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
指定要清除登录凭据的主机账户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance. The instance contains the host account.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
指定要清除登录凭据的主机账户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
> 区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For information about region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 清除指定主机账户登录凭据

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost reset-host-account-credential --instance-id bastionhost-cn-rp640dg0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-account-id 1 --credential-type Password --region cn-hangzhou
